channel.title: Retrocalculated
channel.description: Long-form research articles and shorter Notebook posts spanning history, science, and data-driven topics.

item.title: Half of India's Pregnancies Are Now High-Risk
item.description: NFHS data shows nearly half of pregnancies in India now classified high-risk, driven by rising metabolic disease and answered, unevenly, with surgery.

item.title: The Iron Gap: Why More Than Half of Indian Women Are Anaemic, and Why It Got Worse
item.description: NFHS-5 found 57 percent of Indian women anaemic, up from 53 percent five years earlier, despite a national program built specifically to bring the number down.

item.title: The Fleet That History Forgot: Rajendra Chola I's Campaigns Against Srivijaya
item.description: Rajendra Chola I's 1025 CE naval raid on Srivijaya, and why the popular blue-water navy, total-conquest, and royal-marriage version of the story doesn't survive contact with the inscriptions.

item.title: The Navy Nobody Talks About: Rajendra Chola's War Across the Sea
item.description: A fleet of repurposed merchant ships, a captured king, and a story that's been oversold in almost every retelling since.

item.title: In Silico Identification of Horizontal Gene Transfer: Tracking blaNDM-1 Across Multi-Species Gut Reservoirs
item.description: A comparative genomics study tracing the carbapenem-resistance gene blaNDM-1 as it hops between E. coli and Shigella within the human gut.

item.title: The Mahabharata War: A Meta-Analysis of Astronomical Dating Claims
item.description: Nineteen proposed dates for the Mahabharata war, spanning 5561 BCE to 900 BCE, scored against a shared evidentiary rubric.
